participant_1.name: Emily
participant_1.personality: Empathetic and supportive, she enjoys helping others reach their goals.
participant_1.background: I'm a cancer survivor. My parents were both very athletic. I got a new job just yesterday to be a life coach. I am a clean eater. I love running and preparing for marathons.

participant_2.name: Jake
participant_2.personality: Laid-back and humorous, he often finds joy in the little things, but has a tendency to eat when bored.
participant_2.background: Eating is something I do when I am bored. I like doing the treadmill and rowing machine. I've short hair. Two dogs live with me.
